title: Google Signs CNN to 400 Publisher AI News Pilot

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock
Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. Series A Common Stock

summary:
Internal communications sent to CNN staff reveal that the organization's original reporting will now serve as a foundation for AI-generated answers on Google, with citations linked back to the news outlet. The arrangement allows the search engine to use the network's journalism to inform responses to news queries across various Google products while maintaining clear attribution to the source.

Google has enrolled more than 400 publications in its News AI pilot to test features such as automated overviews, with participants including the Financial Times and The Texas Tribune. While specific terms remain undisclosed, the deal may include the provision of enterprise tools and payment for training models on CNN's content, a structure that differs from Google's agreement with the New York Times.
